description:
Watch rare footage of a massive Oklahoma tornado forming on May 31, 2013. This video captures the intense moment a half-mile wide funnel drops over the plains.

This archive footage documents the development of a major storm system as it moves across the Oklahoma landscape. Viewers can observe the eerie, unnatural green sky that often precedes severe weather events, alongside the immediate reactions of storm observers and highway traffic. It provides a raw, ground-level perspective on how quickly a calm field can transform into a dangerous, large-scale meteorological event.

By examining this May 31 2013 tornado, you gain a clearer understanding of the visual signs associated with significant tornado formation. The footage serves as a historical record of the storm's size and the chaotic atmosphere surrounding its path. Whether you are a weather enthusiast or studying storm chasing footage, this clip illustrates the sheer scale of extreme weather in the Midwest.

Subscribe for more archival weather documentation and historical storm breakdowns. Tell us in the comments what other historic storm events you would like to see covered next.

For copyright and business inquiries, contact us at: darkhorizonyt.contact@gmail.com
